rawContent: @Redcountessa @chelleryn99 @earthygirl011 @TheGreenParty You don't have to forgive. We all have to try to make sure the leadership don't repeat the same mistakes. The country is facing an existential threat from #ClimateCrisis and #CharterCities Starmer has disabled Labour. We are running out of time.

@PatKelly1158 @emmyzen Whatever you think of the monarchy, Charles 'gets' the urgency and seriousness of the #ClimateEmergency .
The question is now, will he use his position to try to help tackle it, or just cling to continuity non-intervention?

@RaggedTP He, as an individual, has some good points: he understands the threat of the #ClimateEmergency more than most and also supports both small family farms and disadvantaged young people. Whether his new position within the machine allows him to push those issues, remains to be seen.
